title: On her walk to campus, Debra Kennard found the empty shop that became Gold Shoe Books

posts.facebook:
Years of bookshop plans never added up. Then Debra Kennard saw an empty shop on her walk to work.

How Debra Kennard, who worked at Washington University in St. Louis, opened Gold Shoe Books in a 300 sq ft shop in University City at 57; why independent bookshops are opening again on both sides of the Atlantic; and how to test a shop idea before you sign a lease.

A plan that does not work on paper can work when the right place turns up, so keep the plan ready and keep your eyes open.

Read the full story → https://dontdieretired.com/earn/debra-kennard-gold-shoe-books/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=daily
